tasks.stop_or_rollback: Do not use a broad file deletion to remove an untested required child state.

tasks.title: Attribute remaining service tails and ownership
implementation_steps: Identify each service thread/core, storage client, synchronization point and buffer owner in the current build.
Classify BGM refill, FGM startup, remaining motion demand and other storage events by bytes, event frequency, blocked work and deadlines.
Price event-window totals instead of medians that discard infrequent refills; separate unused idle from blocking service.
Choose the next service mechanism only from remaining measured cost, preserving the direct-read optimizations already retained.
tasks.validation: T-AUDIO event/underrun/late-cue witness and T-MEAS exclusive service attribution; no double-counting background work.
tasks.work_to_retire: Unclassified storage clients and repeated ownership guesses; no speed credit yet.
tasks.completion: All recurring services have a declared owner, budget/deadline and measured interference.
tasks.stop_or_rollback: Do not claim zero I/O from zero libfat calls or assume ARM7 has spare capacity without measurement.

tasks.title: Convert audio control and eliminate unnecessary decode work
implementation_steps: Convert pitch/rate, envelope/volume, pan and event/control arithmetic through fixed/native integer consumers.
Move invariant source-format conversion or sample preparation to host generators using the current supported playback API/format.
Keep cue identity, duration, loop/seam behavior, voice priority and audible simultaneous events correct under four-way bursts.
Remove completed-domain float/libm paths and repeated runtime setup that the native asset/control representation replaces.
tasks.validation: T-AUDIO source cue events, seam/finite-track completion, pitch/pan/volume bounds, burst priorities and T-FLOAT audio roots.
tasks.work_to_retire: Audio-control float and host-convertible runtime decode/setup, not audio content.

tasks.title: Bound buffers, prefetch and storage scheduling
source_or_edit_targets: scene admission and storage service seam
implementation_steps: Reserve BGM and required cue buffers with explicit lifetime and worst-case service interference.
Choose resident or deadline-safe one-shot policy from measured latency and legal cue bursts; do not copy the BGM streaming exemption to every cue.
Prioritize/coalesce declared range requests only where order/cursor/loop semantics permit, and avoid filesystem discovery inside playback starts.
Prove fallback/error handling does not duplicate playback, reuse a live buffer or silently lose a required cue.

Service envelopes include legal simultaneous cues/projectiles from repeated and distinct fighters on each stage's music/hazard workload. Keep audio deadline leaders separate from CPU P95 and heap leaders; no required cue is silently dropped to hold timing.
tasks.validation: T-AUDIO delayed/short/failed read injection, simultaneous cues, loop boundaries, cancellation and source event order; T-RES reserves and zero undeclared demand.
tasks.work_to_retire: Unnecessary per-event allocation/discovery and avoidable non-overlapped service tails.
tasks.completion: Declared services meet deadlines under the hardest complete scene with explicit memory cost.
tasks.stop_or_rollback: A bigger buffer that causes battle admission OOM or a rare missing sound is not a win.

tasks.title: Overlap hardware math only under proven ownership
implementation_steps: Inventory every divide/sqrt register writer in the current linked binary including library, thread and IRQ paths; discard old no-preemption assumptions unless re-proven.
For a measured remaining independent operation, split start/consume and schedule useful native work between them without allowing another writer to overwrite the result.
Define ownership/save-restore or bounded critical section at the shared-unit boundary; do not add broad interrupt masking at every call.
Compare with the already-existing synchronous native helper, including ownership overhead and interrupt/service effects.
tasks.validation: T-HWMATH overlapping/cancelled/preempted operations and exact domain results; T-AUDIO IRQ deadline integrity; whole-frame timing.
tasks.work_to_retire: Only actual exposed wait latency for a qualified math chain.
tasks.completion: A retained asynchronous schedule improves total cost with correct cross-user ownership, or the synchronous route remains.
tasks.stop_or_rollback: Do not count hardware math as newly implemented or adopt overlap on a stale register-writer audit.

tasks.title: Select and price one ARM7 candidate
implementation_steps: Select one coarse independent job with measured critical-path cost and demonstrable ARM7 service slack, such as preparation of non-immediate service data.
Compute input/output bytes, copy/cache cost, queue latency, deadline, cancellation and resident-memory budget before writing the worker.
Prototype an equivalent native CPU control and one bounded worker implementation without displacing SDK audio/input/storage services.
If no job qualifies, close this optional task as NOT_SELECTED with evidence; do not manufacture an offload requirement.
tasks.validation: T-IPC protocol schema/ranges/generations and baseline slack; T-MEAS end-to-end work/deadline evidence.
tasks.work_to_retire: A named non-overlapped job only if measured benefit exceeds communication/contention costs.
tasks.completion: One candidate has a defensible protocol and total-time case, or ARM7 offload is explicitly not needed.
tasks.stop_or_rollback: No same-tick AI/collision offload with new latency; no second ARM7 storage service that duplicates an existing one.

tasks.title: Prove worker coherency, cancellation and net gain
implementation_steps: Implement C7/C5-style explicit ownership with completed cache-visible inputs and uniquely owned output buffers outside TCM.
Handle queue-full, timeout, late completion, scene-generation retirement and cancellation acknowledgement without freeing a possible live writer.
Inject ordering/delay/failure races and prove services remain responsive; a late result cannot change another scene’s state.
Measure CPU work, total frame/cadence, deadlines and memory versus the control. Retain only a whole-system winner; otherwise remove the worker/queue.
tasks.validation: T-IPC stale reply, same-address reuse, cancellation race, full queue and double publication; T-AUDIO deadlines; serial uncontaminated timing.
tasks.work_to_retire: Actual critical-path ARM9 work after all worker overheads, or removal of a failed optional prototype.
tasks.completion: A selected offload is safe and faster end to end; an unselected/failed route leaves no permanent framework.
tasks.stop_or_rollback: Never report a faster ARM9 bracket while the join, DMA contention or audio underrun moved elsewhere.

tasks.title: Close audio/service runtime numerics and reachability
implementation_steps: Audit both processor/service build roots and all cold error/transition/control paths for remaining floating arithmetic.
Remove completed-domain native/legacy duplicate service state and experimental routes not retained.
Preserve platform startup/shutdown/return-to-loader and established service lifecycle while narrowing the arithmetic/runtime surface.
Publish declared service classes, deadline evidence and the final fixed-runtime service result with matching build identity.
tasks.validation: T-FLOAT both target cores/services, T-AUDIO cue/loop/shutdown and T-LIFE transitions; no unknown arithmetic roots.
tasks.work_to_retire: Remaining reachable audio/service float and retired worker/control scaffolding.
tasks.completion: Services satisfy the owner’s runtime-fixed requirement, independently of battle-loop arithmetic.
tasks.stop_or_rollback: Do not exempt cold audio/control code from the all-runtime endpoint or alter library internals without a reproducible build.

tasks.title: Close the whole-runtime float and retirement ledger
implementation_steps: Run the complete source/type/lowering/link/caller audit on all shipped scene/service roots and resolve every temporary numeric allowlist entry.
Remove remaining duplicate authority, float conversion shims, integer IEEE arithmetic, obsolete graphics recorders and unreachable experimental helpers.
Keep source data/oracles host-side and source behavior references read-only; verify target object membership prevents their accidental inclusion.
Reconcile removal at input-section granularity and eliminate cold float formatting/transition/math-library roots as well as hot battle calls.

Prove retirement across the entire product-required content catalogue, including cold and unimplemented-required consumers. An unfinished legal owner prevents a universal retirement/completeness claim; shipped pilot reachability may be reported separately.
tasks.validation: T-FLOAT zero unresolved runtime arithmetic roots; T-RETIRE bridge/caller/data absence; weak/indirect/varargs/custom-IEEE negative fixtures.
tasks.work_to_retire: All remaining runtime floating arithmetic and completed-domain compatibility dependencies.
tasks.completion: The owner’s fixed-runtime endpoint is structurally proved across shipped configurations, not inferred from one trace.
tasks.stop_or_rollback: Any unresolved callback or cold path keeps this task OPEN; do not rename helpers or suppress checker findings.

tasks.title: Pack compact CPU-hot state into DTCM
implementation_steps: Rank native mutable records by repeated CPU accesses and measured main-RAM cost per byte. Split cold fields before placement.
Test same-content single-authority location changes; update one base pointer at initialization rather than branch per access or synchronize two copies.
Account for alignment, runtime stacks, interrupts, boot and all scene transitions within the qualified ceiling.
Test combined packing and keep only whole-frame winners. Exclude every DMA/IPC/resource buffer requiring external visibility.
tasks.validation: T-TCM no-inaccessible-buffer and stack-canary/low-water tests; T-MEAS individual and combined placement; T-LIFE startup/transitions.
tasks.work_to_retire: Avoidable data-cache/memory stalls on the final compact CPU working set.
tasks.completion: The measured DTCM map improves integrated cost within current stack and ownership proof.
tasks.stop_or_rollback: No ceiling increase without new stack proof; no permanent DTCM/main-RAM state mirror.

tasks.title: Repack ITCM around final kernels
implementation_steps: Rebuild the byte/caller/execution census after removing helper families and old renderer state; do not reuse a historical tenant ranking.
Remove placement from necessary cold code, shrink cold-inside-hot tails where still present and rank current gameplay/pose/emit kernels.
Test placement-only candidates and combined working sets with full literal/veneer/alias accounting.
Update placement assertions and record current code bytes by subsystem without treating a predetermined renderer/game split as a performance law.

Rank resident kernels on a measured suite containing all relevant mechanism/cost leaders, not one roster. Preserve measured legal-case performance in the final packing and invalidate affected timing evidence when linked layout changes.
tasks.validation: T-TCM linked/kernel identity, startup/IRQ/interworking and whole-frame profiling in final configuration.
tasks.work_to_retire: Avoidable instruction fetch stalls and remaining cold code occupying final ITCM.
tasks.completion: ITCM residents are explicitly justified by current measured benefit and all bytes fit.
tasks.stop_or_rollback: Do not evict an interrupt/startup/rare-required path as dead because of a short trace.

tasks.title: Tune only remaining measured kernels
implementation_steps: Inspect the highest remaining exclusive kernels for redundant loads, spills, unnecessary 64-bit divides, missed constant folding, wide structures and call/veneer overhead.
Test one causal codegen change at a time: smaller affine form, load reuse, ARM/Thumb choice, optimization level or controlled inlining.
Write small assembly only when C output leaves a specific measurable gap; define ABI, clobbers, alignment, overflow and caller obligations and retain an independent host reference.
Remeasure the whole configuration after each retained batch; larger unrolling/code size can defeat cache/ITCM gains.
tasks.validation: T-NUM exact/bounded operation corpus, ARM9 codegen/ABI tests, T-MEAS net whole-frame gain and T-TCM fit.
tasks.work_to_retire: Remaining avoidable native instructions/memory stalls, not source-level complexity for its own sake.
tasks.completion: Every kept tuning change has a mechanism, tests and integrated evidence.
tasks.stop_or_rollback: Reject a microbenchmark win with worse total time or code-size pressure; do not use fast-math to fake fixed-point migration.

tasks.title: Remove experimental routes and rebuild shipping shape
implementation_steps: Remove losing/native A/B routes, route selectors, debug-only witnesses and migration allowlists from the shipping target.
Regenerate assets from pinned input and build source-normal natural-input smash64ds with no fast logic, scripted walk or demand-exclusion flags.
Keep matched ROM/ELF/config hashes and rerun integrated relevant verification plus product performance evaluation.
Compare final hard-on results to qualified experimental results; report placement/instrument differences instead of assuming they match.
tasks.validation: T-BUILD reproducible clean-input build, T-FLOAT final roots, T-MEAS final shipping scope and T-COVER natural input.
tasks.work_to_retire: Temporary dual implementations, experiment knobs and measurement-only dependencies from final runtime.
tasks.completion: The final binary, not just a routed experimental build, meets its current acceptance gates.
tasks.stop_or_rollback: A routed A/B success does not permit publishing an unmeasured hard-on ROM.

tasks.title: Publish the final architecture and resource ownership map
implementation_steps: Update existing owners with concise final API/units/lifetime and generated-data descriptions; archive obsolete experiment detail rather than retaining contradictory runtime comments.
Publish exact final RAM/TCM/code/bank/transient budgets and the before/after work-deletion ledger.
Keep one authoritative queue and short restart pointer; documentation describes actual retained source, not planned but unlanded work.
Remove stale instructions that pin retired renderer or float-helper dependencies into future builds.
tasks.validation: T-DOC links/source/task references and final artifact identities; implementation and comments agree.
tasks.work_to_retire: Stale policy and restart ambiguity that could reintroduce retired paths.
tasks.completion: A new agent can identify current owners, constraints and acceptance without reading the full historical campaign.
tasks.stop_or_rollback: Do not label an unmet performance/content/numeric gate FIXED in the handoff.

tasks.title: Define universal roster-stage and interaction obligations
implementation_steps: Use N00.06 to derive the full product-required fighter/stage catalogue, every unordered four-fighter multiset and every ordered four-slot roster; never silently reduce it to enabled or presently accepted content.

Specify one reproducible source-normal, items-enabled four-CPU full scored battle for EVERY base roster-stage case. Freeze slot assignment, source-legal rules, CPU profile, seed/input procedure, start/stop policy and completeness witnesses before results are known.

Track runtime slot-permutation, costume/team, CPU-level, control-mode and quality/detail obligations separately from base roster-stage coverage. Resource equivalence, mechanical symmetry and timing equivalence are different proof scopes; an unproved permutation remains a runtime obligation.

Design directed and four-way state tours for all required mechanisms: copy/morph/capture, duplicate writable state, overlapping projectiles and VFX, moving hazards, item/summon children, camera extremes, audio bursts and late lifecycle states. Source-legal natural tests grade performance; manipulated diagnostic states are separately labelled.

Define DEV_FAST for local tests, SCREEN for prioritization and RELEASE_EXHAUSTIVE for final base-case and assigned permutation coverage. Pairwise/targeted testing supplements, never replaces, the release base matrix.
Pin dependency fingerprints and conservative invalidation rules. Produce separate current-content and full-product reports, with missing planned content shown as BLOCKED rather than absent.
tasks.validation: T-COVER COV01–COV18; exact required sets and counts reconcile; every base case and assigned permutation/variant obligation has a finite declared procedure, not just a fighter/stage mention.
tasks.work_to_retire: Sampled interaction coverage being presented as universal roster-stage qualification.
tasks.completion: The source-derived required sets, exact case universe, full-match procedures, supplemental interactions, slot-proof policy and requalification triggers are frozen and reproducible.
tasks.stop_or_rollback: A representative sample is useful during development but cannot satisfy RELEASE_EXHAUSTIVE or shrink the full product scope.

tasks.title: Run controlled and natural four-way performance qualification
source_or_edit_targets: final shipping and matching profiling builds
implementation_steps: On final hard-on builds, run the RELEASE_EXHAUSTIVE base matrix: a complete scored source-normal battle window for every unordered four-fighter roster on every selectable VS stage, with its actual slot assignment and current-content identity verified inside the guest.

Discharge every ordered-slot runtime obligation under the explicit proof policy. A functional symmetry certificate does not discharge timing. Run unproved assignments and variants with their declared full-match or focused protocol; there is no default 24-way performance symmetry assumption.

For each required run, grade work and cadence separately using its entire declared population and collect same-run native output, actual four-way engagement, resource limits, audio deadlines, GPU completion and clock coverage. Use a source clock/time endpoint; do not assume the historical frame 1973 endpoint survives the speedup.

Execute N10.09 controlled and natural adverse-interaction cases and maintain separate measured CPU, cadence, RAM, VRAM/palette, GPU/overdraw and service leader sets. Fixed level-3 stress remains a regression fixture, not evidence that every legal CPU/control profile is covered.

Reconcile expected and observed case IDs through N10.08. Persist and report every failed, blocked, stale, infrastructure-invalid or unexecuted obligation. A known legal failure blocks universal qualification even when not one of the originally chosen leaders.

For RED results, retain the passing work already validated at unchanged identities, report the exact failing case and cause, fix it, and rerun the conservatively affected set. Never drop failed seeds, shorten costly runs or choose only successful retries.
tasks.validation: T-MEAS per-case product gates and T-COVER exact-set release reconciliation; zero unexplained missing/stale/blocked cases; explicit honest scope for finite dynamic histories.
tasks.work_to_retire: No runtime work by itself; this proves or rejects the integrated performance endpoint.
tasks.completion: Every required base case and assigned ordered/variant/interaction obligation has valid passing evidence, with independent per-case work/cadence gates and no known failing legal configuration. This qualifies the declared finite matrix, not all possible input histories.
tasks.stop_or_rollback: One legal failing case, unresolved required permutation, unavailable required fighter/stage or missing result keeps universal acceptance OPEN; pooled percentiles cannot override it.

tasks.title: Qualify lifecycle, memory and service stability
implementation_steps: Test CSS→battle→results→CSS, rematch, sudden death, pause, KO/respawn, copy/morph, intro and shipped mode transitions.
Collect allocation/stack/TCM/graphics/packet/IPC and audio service evidence; test interrupted admission/cancellation and repeated arena address reuse.
Use long natural soaks for leak and rare deadline behavior only after focused tests pass; keep timing measurements isolated from concurrent correctness runners.
Confirm no mandatory locked-epoch motion/texture reads and no undeclared service clients appear late in a match.

Exercise transitions that change roster/stage sets, including four same-kind to four distinct kinds and back, legal costumes/team layouts, and reused instance addresses. Link resource/lifecycle results to configuration keys; a successful allocation for one case cannot stand in for every allocation shape.
tasks.validation: T-LIFE/T-RES/T-AUDIO/T-IPC applicable tests, full coverage beyond the stress script’s 60→1 clock window.
tasks.work_to_retire: No runtime work by itself; validates long-lived ownership and resource closure.
tasks.completion: No leaks/stale handles/late writers/underruns or unqualified scene gaps remain in the claimed shipped scope.
tasks.stop_or_rollback: The 1,972-frame battle script does not cover results/rematch; missing lifecycle coverage blocks this task.

tasks.title: Qualify visual, mechanical and numeric completeness
implementation_steps: Run exact discrete gameplay/event/order tests, bounded continuous error reports and native geometry/material/transform tests across the qualification matrix.
Capture tricky visual states with expected-owner/resource identities and actual pixels; preserve all required content regardless of aggregate error counters.
Run the no-float audit on every shipped scene/service root, including menus and cold callbacks, with no temporary migration allowance.
Record unresolved pre-existing content defects separately; they cannot be ignored when claiming full-game completeness.

Reconcile required content sets with N10.08, including disabled unfinished fighters/stages and required child owners. Use zero omissions and explicit variant/permutation evidence; report sampled dynamic histories honestly rather than claiming exhaustive behavior proof.
tasks.validation: T-NUM/T-CLOCK/T-PHYS/T-COLL/T-HIT/T-AI/T-ORDER/T-GEOM/T-DEPTH/T-UI/T-FLOAT.
tasks.work_to_retire: No runtime work by itself; proves representation and fidelity closure.
tasks.completion: Claimed shipped scope has complete native mechanics/presentation and fixed runtime without disguised IEEE helpers.
tasks.stop_or_rollback: A matching sampled state hash alone or zero no-op error counters are insufficient.

tasks.title: Reproduce the release from declared inputs
implementation_steps: Rebuild the natural-input P2 target from recorded source and declared ignored derived inputs without relying on unrelated dirty files.
Run generator-staleness, native-only, runtime numerics, ABI/architecture and the widest relevant integration profile; inspect all final verdicts.
Pin final ROM/ELF/config/generator/emulator/verifier identities and attach timing, content, memory and service coverage.
Confirm the published target is smash64ds.nds, not a fast-logic/tick-hud/forced-item lab target or the frozen P1 artifact.

Publish the coverage-ledger digest, catalogue digest and per-case qualification identities with the release. Reuse existing final-binary runs only if the rebuilt ROM/ELF/config and relevant inputs are identical; otherwise mark their obligations stale and rerun the affected set before release.
tasks.validation: T-BUILD clean reproducibility and exact final identity; no broken umbrella bypassed as GREEN.
tasks.work_to_retire: Accidental undeclared dependencies and false publication acceptance.
tasks.completion: A reproducible release artifact is covered by all required final gates.
tasks.stop_or_rollback: Compile success or a prior green hash does not qualify a changed ROM.

tasks.title: Close or report the precise remaining gap
implementation_steps: Publish measured before/after performance with the exact baseline comparison scope, per-case gate outcomes, coverage counts, independent resource/cadence/service leaders and all open failures. Do not quote only the best lineup or pool unrelated case rows.

Close universal four-fighter performance only after the full required base/ordered-obligation ledger is reconciled and all legal known failures are resolved. A scoped current-content checkpoint may be KEEP but is not full-product closure.
Summarize retired work categories and the final architecture, not lines rewritten or hypothetical summed savings. Preserve unrelated P2 content rows and the one existing execution board.

On relevant content/code/toolchain/SDK/emulator changes, invalidate affected evidence, rescreen prior leaders and new cases, and reopen the existing P2-2p8 row with exact failing configuration and cause. Broad linked-layout changes conservatively invalidate timing across all cases.
tasks.validation: T-DOC and T-COVER final exact-set report agrees with case artifacts; no unsupported all-combination, universal-history or aggregate-speedup claims.
tasks.work_to_retire: Ambiguous completion claims and duplicated status tracking.
tasks.completion: The board clearly separates local implementation, current-content coverage, exhaustive declared roster-stage qualification, fixed-runtime closure and any remaining full-game work.
tasks.stop_or_rollback: No measured pass means no closure; preserve the recoverable checkpoint and next concrete owner instead.

tasks.title: Implement a resumable exhaustive matrix runner
implementation_steps: Consume the immutable required case catalogue and release profile. Reuse existing build/runner/ring capture infrastructure instead of adding another target scheduler or parallel build fleet.

Add a verified scenario configuration path: configure before admission/GO, then attest the ACTUAL ordered fighter IDs, stage, CPU/control/rules settings and generated/native owners inside the guest. Existing fixed-roster script arguments must not be assumed to accept a new case.

Support DEV_FAST, SCREEN and RELEASE_EXHAUSTIVE separately. Short probes can prioritize fixes; only valid full scored populations can populate release timing obligations. A fast-logic/forced-item fixture never substitutes for a natural run.

Measure by declared source-clock/GO-to-Time-Up policy with the established rare-overrun allowance, not a fixed present-count copied from the original slow ROM. Record intro/lifecycle windows separately; validate ring collection for a faster match that produces fewer presents.

Use unique immutable case/run IDs, files and disposable storage. Save atomic progress records only after child exit, hash verification, output validation and explicit per-case grading. Shard/resume without deleting failures or reusing stale evidence.

Serialize all timing/visual acceptance and shared builds as VERIFYING.md prescribes. Parallelize host enumeration/solver checks or isolated non-timing correctness only when allowed; never launch thousands of timing emulators concurrently.

Reattempt an infrastructure-invalid run only after recording and resolving its cause. Retain game failures; new attempts do not erase them. Missing/blocked/stale cases remain visible through to N10.08.
tasks.validation: T-COVER runner fixtures: interruption/resume, wrong guest roster, duplicate output, stale hash, failed child, incomplete ring, changed catalogue and exactly-once case reconciliation; T-MEAS valid full-clock population.
tasks.work_to_retire: Manual sampled roster selection and lost or silently replaced matrix results.
tasks.completion: The runner can enumerate, stage, attest, collect, resume and grade every required case reproducibly without altering shipping gameplay or conflating short screening with release proof.
tasks.stop_or_rollback: No runtime case-selector or trustworthy full-window collection means BLOCKED infrastructure, not passing coverage; do not manufacture case support from copied logs.

tasks.title: Implement exact-set per-case release reconciliation
implementation_steps: Derive required base, ordered/permutation and variant/interaction obligation sets from catalogue plus qualification policy. Do not take the set of returned results as the expected universe.

Validate result identities, actual guest configuration, full-window completeness, relevant artifact fingerprints, positive engagement/native output, resources/services and per-run work/cadence verdicts.

Permit evidence reuse only for an explicit property-scoped certificate or unchanged validated identity. An admission equivalence cannot satisfy timing; no generic pass_all_slots or global average is accepted.

Report required, measured-valid-pass, measured-fail, blocked, not-run, stale, infrastructure-invalid and properly certified-equivalent obligation sets separately. Missing data is UNKNOWN; a single known legal failure blocks universal PASS.

Check every required run and configuration separately, then AND their verdicts. Never pool frames across lineups or let one fast duplicate compensate for a slow mixed roster; keep all mandatory seeds and diagnostic scope labels.

Implement negative fixtures COV01–COV18, especially one missing case, one bad case amid many good ones, same-count substitution, fake permutation proof, cross-ROM reuse and a safe rejected legal match.
Keep current-content progress separate from full-product completion and explicitly state finite input/history coverage. Reconcile new content or invalidated evidence before updating the one P2 board.
tasks.validation: T-COVER COV01–COV18 plus T-MEAS per-case gates; set identities and all independent verdicts must agree with immutable source/result manifests.
tasks.work_to_retire: False universal acceptance from pooled metrics, missing cases, guessed equivalence or a reduced enabled roster.
tasks.completion: A strict reconciler emits PASS only for a complete valid declared matrix with no known failing legal configurations; it otherwise reports exact unresolved obligations without claiming universal-history proof.
tasks.stop_or_rollback: Any fabricated, missing, stale, case-mismatched or unjustifiably reused result is invalid and cannot be rescued by an aggregate green summary.

tasks.title: Qualify adverse four-way interactions and separate cost leaders
source_or_edit_targets: existing state-tour/input tools and source event oracles
proposed interaction manifest and leader report
implementation_steps: Define source-legal controlled tours for interactions not reliably exercised by one natural minute: four simultaneous projectiles/effects, multiple independent Kirby copies, captures/throws and held items, duplicate morph/status changes, and foreground/background depth intersections.

Cross stage mechanisms with fighter mechanisms: moving-platform attachment and ledge recovery, hazards near blast zones, item/summon bursts, camera zoom extremes, transparent overdraw and audio cue overlaps. Verify the setup itself follows legal capacity and source laws.

Cover legal CPU levels and control/team variants as separately declared obligations. Four-CPU mode is a stress tool; one-human/three-CPU source-input playback and difficult human-triggered states remain required where applicable.

Maintain independent leaders for WORK-H P95, cadence/consecutive misses, RAM/transient peaks, texture/palette/view capacity, matrix/geometry/FIFO/overdraw, and audio/storage/IPC deadlines. Never combine independently measured maxima into a claimed real worst-case match.

Use these cases to diagnose and re-price the integrated runtime, while the exhaustive base sweep remains mandatory. Any source-legal failure discovered outside the initial matrix becomes a regression case and a release blocker.

Publish which interactions/seeds/windows were executed and which were structurally bounded. Finite source-state tours do not prove all possible gameplay histories; keep that limitation explicit without narrowing the support requirement.
tasks.validation: T-COVER mechanism obligations and T-COLL/T-HIT/T-ORDER/T-GPU/T-AUDIO positive simultaneous engagement; distinguish natural performance from diagnostic manipulation.
tasks.work_to_retire: One blended worst-case benchmark and individual-feature tests standing in for four-way interaction pressure.
tasks.completion: All declared adverse mechanism cases pass their respective gates, separate measured leaders are reproducible, and no discovered legal interaction failure remains unresolved.
tasks.stop_or_rollback: Do not turn an illegal forced state into a shipping workload claim or hide a legal expensive state by banning its matchup, items, hazard, CPU level or quality setting.
